scripts.typeorm:run: npm run build && node ./node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d dist/config/data-source.js
scripts.typeorm:revert: npm run build && node ./node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:revert -d dist/config/data-source.js
scripts.typeorm:show: npm run build && node ./node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d dist/config/data-source.js
scripts.migration:generate: npm run build && node ./node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:generate src/migrations/auto -d dist/config/data-source.js
